sources.entry: macshot - Screenshot and annotation tool with screen recording, scrolling capture, and OCR. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/sw33tlie/macshot) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: macshot is a free, open-source, native macOS screenshot and annotation tool that also handles screen recording, scroll capture, OCR, and uploads.
summary.what_it_does: It lives in the menu bar and captures a selected region, window, or full screen through global hotkeys, with a Quick Save and Quick OCR option. Its annotation toolkit includes arrows, shapes, text, pencil and marker, numbered markers, stamps and emoji, a color sampler, a measure ruler, a loupe, and a spotlight highlight, plus censor tools that pixelate, blur, fill, or erase content and can auto-redact PII. Screen recording exports MP4 (H.264) or GIF, can include system audio and microphone, and has a built-in trim and export editor. Scroll capture stitches a scrolling region into one tall or wide image using Apple Vision. Output can be uploaded to Google Drive, imgbb, or any S3-compatible service, and the README also covers beautify frames, image adjustments, screenshot history with editable annotations, and 40 interface languages.
use_cases: capture and annotate screenshots on a Mac
record screen or a region as MP4 or GIF with narration
stitch a long scrolling page into one image
extract text from the screen with OCR
redact emails, phone numbers, or API keys in screenshots
upload screenshots to Google Drive, imgbb, or S3 and copy the link
make framed or beautified screenshots for presentations
how_to_run: Or download the latest .dmg from Releases and drag macshot to /Applications
Launch macshot and grant Screen Recording permission when prompted
Press Cmd+Shift+X to capture an area
Annotate with the toolbar, then press Cmd+C to copy
notable: Full annotation suite with 19+ tools, including click-to-select editing of existing annotations
Scroll capture that auto-detects vertical or horizontal scrolling and shows a live preview
Screenshot history where past captures can be reopened and their annotations edited
Auto-redaction of PII and faces, plus a smart erase mode that samples surrounding colors
Uploads to Google Drive, imgbb, or any S3-compatible service
caveats: Requires macOS 12.3 or later; some features need macOS 13, 14, 15, or 26
Screen Recording permission must be granted; the README notes that beta upgrades may require re-granting permissions
Some features are version-limited, such as mesh gradients (macOS 15+) and Liquid Glass theme (macOS 26)
